invariants.rationale: Method is called on a valid HoodieTable, and use of table methods in body assumes non-null.
Methods are invoked on pendingCompactionTimeline, so it cannot be null.
A method is called on operationType, so it must be non-null.
instantTime is used as argument to methods and must be non-null.
getInstantGenerator() is invoked unconditionally, so it must return a non-null object.
